therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation (TLI + ATG + CD34+ cells + T cell add back + MMF + CSP)
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: immune system ablation and reconstitution via allogeneic stem cell engraftment
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: immune tolerance restoration and autoimmune disease remission
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with life-threatening systemic lupus erythematosus
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Time to achieve complete remission (off all immunosuppressive therapy without clinical or laboratory evidence of active disease) within the first year

dose_info.dose: 1200 cGy TLI; rabbit ATG 1.5 mg/kg; MMF 15 mg/kg bid; CSP 6.25 mg/kg
dose_info.schedule: TLI days -11 to -7 and -4 to -1; ATG days -11 to -7; MMF day 0 to day +28; CSP day -3 to 6 months post-transplant
dose_info.dose_modifications: CSP adjusted to maintain trough blood levels of 350-500 ng/ml; withdrawn by 6 months post-transplantation

modulation_entries.hypothesis: TLI depletes host lymphocytes to create space for donor stem cell engraftment, amplifying the immune reconstitution biology of the transplant
modulation_entries.citation: 1200 cGy total lymphoid irradiation (TLI) are administered on day -11 through -7 and days -4 through -1 pretransplantation

modulation_entries.hypothesis: ATG depletes host T cells to reduce rejection risk and facilitate donor stem cell engraftment and immune reconstitution
modulation_entries.citation: rabbit ATG at 1.5 mg/kg i.v. on days -11 through -7 pretransplantation

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Cyclosporine suppresses host and donor T cell activation to prevent graft rejection and GVHD, supporting stable engraftment and immune reconstitution
modulation_entries.citation: cyclosporine (CSP) at initial dose of 6.25 mg/kg and adjusted to maintain trough blood levels of 350-500 ng/ml is begun on day -3 to complete withdrawal by 6 months post-transplantation

modulation_entries.hypothesis: MMF suppresses lymphocyte proliferation to prevent graft rejection and GVHD, supporting stable engraftment and immune reconstitution
modulation_entries.citation: mycophenolate mofetil (MMF) is begun on day 0 at a dose of 15 mg/kg bid and stopped on day +28
